{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:Tutorial2026Icon.png]] |-|Icon = [[File:TutorialBanner.png]] |map = [[Tutorial]] |waves = 7 |starting_cash = {{Money|2,000}} |rewards = {{Coins|250}} & {{Exp|100}} |chapter = TDS: Boot Camp |previous_mission = [[Breach Protocol]] |next_mission = [[The Beginning]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Hold boot camp against the final assault and bring down the Brute.|In-game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Brute Force''' is the fourth and final mission for the tutorial chapter of the [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The loadout for this map is set to be the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]], [[Demoman]] and [[Soldier]]. Sell cost of all towers is also 100% of their total price. Base health is set to infinity and [[Skills]] are disabled. ==Rewards== '''Brute Force''' gives a one time reward of {{Coins|250}} and {{Exp|100}}.
